name: Cultist: Dark Protection raises Abyssal Covenant's healing-received bonus by 20% (#1220)
contract: 704897 effect 0 is ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (aura 107), EffectMiscValue 12 = SPELLMOD_EFFECT2, EffectBasePoints 19 + DieSides 1 = +20, EffectSpellClassMask (2147483648, 0, 0) = word0 bit31. Abyssal Covenant 500751 (SpellFamilyName 31, SpellFamilyFlags (2147483648, 0, 0), exact bit31 match) has effect 1 = Apply Aura SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING_RECEIVED (283), EffectBasePoints -1 + DieSides 1 = base value 0. Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers (Unit.cpp:12149-12167) applies SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 to effect index 1 of any matching spell through Player::ApplySpellMod, so Abyssal Covenant's healing-received bonus becomes 20 once Dark Protection is known, matching the tooltip's '20% increased healing'. 704897 is not in SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod's family-31 collision table (SpellInfo.cpp ~1497), so the plain classmask match is unambiguous. spell_modifier applies the caster's real spell mods to a synthetic base (0, matching Abyssal Covenant's own baseline effect-1 value); spell_effect_value independently reads SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue for that same effect, which is exactly the number Spell::EffectApplyAura would use to build the aura on an ally. 500712 (Ancient Curse, SpellFamilyFlags all zero, a real Cultist damage spell) is the negative control: its classmask AND with Dark Protection's bit31 mask is always zero, so it must stay unaffected by the same modifier op. Numbers read from Spell.dbc via coa-dbc-viewer against ~/CoaServer/client-dbc/original-2026-09-17. No script or SQL references 704897 or 500751; this is native AzerothCore spellmod plumbing. Regression guard for behaviour that already works natively.
